gates.detail: Required technical-study semantic hierarchy is present.
Published roller/idler counts represented; centers and flange geometry reconstructed.
Readable reconstructed visual teeth; count and pitch are not manufacturer facts.
Pose-following visual hose routing is reconstructed; lengths, fittings, pressures, and clamp points remain unresolved.
Evaluated retained-pose bucket-tooth vertices must not penetrate the Y=0 grade plane.
Study is detailed enough for review and remains inside the reconstructed web-study budget.
Seven deterministic review renders have non-trivial bytes and luminance range; human visual review remains pending.
The 30 degree published value is retained, but the brochure is not a scale drawing and the complete rear swept envelope has not been qualified.
The 2.18 m foundry-bucket turn radius is retained as a motion constraint; no travel/steering swept-volume solver exists in this structural study.
Exact pivot and link geometry is unresolved; structural-study beams are not a qualified solver.
Exact tilt-linkage topology and anchors are unresolved.
Cylinder anchors and strokes are reconstructed and not yet mechanically qualified.
Collision proxies exist but no swept-pose collision solver has run.
No swept-volume self-collision qualification has run.
Track path is a static visual reconstruction; pitch and phase remain unresolved.
Quick-attach and exact foundry bucket identity are unresolved.
Overall critic has not yet approved the exact render and artifact hashes.
No shared-viewer integration or browser qualification is claimed.
Only the overall publisher may advance or deploy this study.
